# Well-Architected Framework
A workload's gaps against the five pillars of the Azure Well-Architected Framework: Reliability, Security, Cost Optimization, Operational Excellence and Performance Efficiency. Each pillar combines Azure Advisor's recommendations with configuration checks read from Azure Resource Graph, so no workspace is needed.

parameters.name: Subscription
parameters.label: Subscriptions
parameters.query:
summarize by subscriptionId
| project value = strcat('/subscriptions/', subscriptionId), label = subscriptionId

parameters.name: WorkloadTag
parameters.label: Workload tag
parameters.description: The tag whose value names the workload a resource belongs to. Tag names here match case.

parameters.name: Workload
parameters.label: Workload
parameters.query:
resources
| extend wl = tostring(tags['{WorkloadTag}'])
| where isnotempty(wl)
| summarize Resources = count() by wl
| project value = wl, label = strcat(wl, '  (', Resources, ' resources)')
| order by value asc
parameters.description: The workloads to review, from the values of the workload tag. All includes untagged resources.

content.query:
resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.cache/redis', 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters', 'microsoft.documentdb/databaseaccounts', 'microsoft.keyvault/vaults', 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways', 'microsoft.network/azurefirewalls', 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers', 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses', 'microsoft.network/virtualnetworkgateways', 'microsoft.sql/servers/databases', 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts', 'microsoft.web/serverfarms')
| where '*' in ({Workload}) or tostring(tags['{WorkloadTag}']) in ({Workload})
| extend Findings = pack_array(
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines' and ((isnull(zones) or array_length(zones) == 0) and isempty(tostring(properties.availabilitySet.id)) and isempty(tostring(properties.virtualMachineScaleSet.id))), pack('Finding', 'VM with no availability zone, availability set or scale set', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize), 'Fix', 'Run two or more instances across availability zones, or record the single point of failure as accepted'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses' and (tostring(sku.name) =~ 'Basic'), pack('Finding', 'Basic SKU public IP (retired September 2025)', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', tostring(properties.ipAddress), 'Fix', 'Upgrade to a Standard SKU public IP'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers' and (tostring(sku.name) =~ 'Basic'), pack('Finding', 'Basic SKU load balancer (retired September 2025)', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Upgrade to a Standard load balancer'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways' and (tostring(properties.sku.tier) in~ ('Standard', 'WAF')), pack('Finding', 'Application Gateway v1 (retired April 2026)', 'Severity', 'High', 'Detail', tostring(properties.sku.name), 'Fix', 'Migrate to Application Gateway v2'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways' and (tostring(properties.sku.tier) in~ ('Standard_v2', 'WAF_v2') and (isnull(zones) or array_length(zones) < 2)), pack('Finding', 'Application Gateway not spread across zones', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(properties.sku.name), 'Fix', 'Redeploy the gateway across availability zones'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/azurefirewalls' and ((isnull(zones) or array_length(zones) < 2)), pack('Finding', 'Azure Firewall not spread across zones', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(properties.sku.tier), 'Fix', 'Deploy the firewall across availability zones'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/virtualnetworkgateways' and (not(tostring(properties.sku.name) endswith 'AZ') and tostring(properties.sku.name) !~ 'ErGwScale'), pack('Finding', 'VPN or ExpressRoute gateway SKU is not zone-redundant', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(properties.gatewayType), ' ', tostring(properties.sku.name)), 'Fix', 'Move to an AZ SKU (or ErGwScale for ExpressRoute)'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts' and (tostring(sku.name) endswith '_LRS'), pack('Finding', 'Storage account is locally redundant (LRS)', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.name), ' ', kind), 'Fix', 'Use ZRS, or GZRS for data that must survive the loss of a region'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms' and (tolower(tostring(sku.tier)) !in ('free', 'shared', 'dynamic', 'basic', 'elasticpremium', 'flexconsumption') and toint(sku.capacity) < 2), pack('Finding', 'App Service plan runs a single instance', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.name), ' x', tostring(sku.capacity)), 'Fix', 'Run at least two instances (three with zone redundancy)'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms' and (tolower(tostring(sku.tier)) in ('premiumv2', 'premiumv3', 'premium0v3', 'premiummv3', 'isolatedv2') and tobool(properties.zoneRedundant) != true), pack('Finding', 'App Service plan not zone-redundant', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Turn on zone redundancy (needs three or more instances)'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.sql/servers/databases' and (name !~ 'master' and tostring(sku.tier) !in~ ('Basic', 'Standard', 'Free', 'System') and tobool(properties.zoneRedundant) != true), pack('Finding', 'SQL database not zone-redundant', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.tier), ' ', tostring(sku.name)), 'Fix', 'Turn on zone redundancy'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' and (tostring(properties.agentPoolProfiles) !contains '"availabilityZones":["'), pack('Finding', 'AKS node pools not spread across zones', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(properties.kubernetesVersion), 'Fix', 'Create node pools across availability zones'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' and (tostring(sku.tier) =~ 'Free'), pack('Finding', 'AKS cluster on the Free tier (no uptime SLA)', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Use the Standard tier for production clusters'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.keyvault/vaults' and (tobool(properties.enablePurgeProtection) != true), pack('Finding', 'Key Vault without purge protection', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Turn on purge protection so a deleted key or secret can always be recovered'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.cache/redis' and (tostring(properties.sku.name) =~ 'Basic'), pack('Finding', 'Azure Cache for Redis on the Basic tier (one node, no SLA)', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(properties.sku.family), tostring(properties.sku.capacity)), 'Fix', 'Use Standard or Premium for anything beyond development'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.documentdb/databaseaccounts' and (coalesce(array_length(properties.locations), 0) < 2 and tostring(properties.locations) !contains '"isZoneRedundant":true'), pack('Finding', 'Cosmos DB account in one region with no zone redundancy', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(properties.locations[0].locationName), 'Fix', 'Turn on zone redundancy, or add a second region'), dynamic(null)))
| mv-expand f = Findings
| where isnotempty(tostring(f.Finding))
| project Severity = tostring(f.Severity), Finding = tostring(f.Finding), id, Detail = tostring(f.Detail),
    Fix = tostring(f.Fix), Type = type, ResourceGroup = resourceGroup, subscriptionId
| summarize Findings = count(), High = countif(Severity == 'High'), Resources = dcount(id)
| extend k = 1
| join kind=leftouter (
    advisorresources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.advisor/recommendations'
    | extend Category = tostring(properties.category)
    | extend Pillar = case(Category =~ 'HighAvailability', 'Reliability', Category =~ 'Cost', 'Cost Optimization',
            Category =~ 'OperationalExcellence', 'Operational Excellence', Category =~ 'Performance', 'Performance Efficiency',
            Category),
        Impact = tostring(properties.impact),
        Problem = tostring(properties.shortDescription.problem),
        Solution = tostring(properties.shortDescription.solution),
        RecType = tostring(properties.recommendationTypeId),
        rid = tolower(tostring(properties.resourceMetadata.resourceId)),
        Savings = coalesce(todouble(properties.extendedProperties.annualSavingsAmount),
            12 * todouble(properties.extendedProperties.savingsAmount)),
        Currency = tostring(properties.extendedProperties.savingsCurrency)
    | join kind=leftouter (
        resources
        | where not('*' in ({Workload}))
        | where tostring(tags['{WorkloadTag}']) in ({Workload})
        | project rid = tolower(id), inWorkload = true
      ) on rid
    | where '*' in ({Workload}) or inWorkload == true
    | where Pillar == 'Reliability'
    | summarize Advisor = count(), AdvisorHigh = countif(Impact =~ 'High')
    | extend k = 1
  ) on k
| extend Advisor = coalesce(Advisor, 0), AdvisorHigh = coalesce(AdvisorHigh, 0)
| project Signal = 'Reliability', Value = Findings + Advisor,
    Detail = strcat(High + AdvisorHigh, ' high · ', Advisor, ' from Advisor'),
    State = case(High + AdvisorHigh > 0, 'Unavailable', Findings + Advisor > 0, 'Degraded', 'Available')

    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.containerregistry/registries' and (tobool(properties.adminUserEnabled) == true), pack('Finding', 'Container registry admin user enabled', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Turn off the admin user; pull with managed identities or scoped tokens'), dynamic(null)),

    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.servicebus/namespaces' and (tobool(properties.disableLocalAuth) != true), pack('Finding', 'Key-based (local) authentication enabled', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Turn off local authentication and use Entra ID'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.eventhub/namespaces' and (tobool(properties.disableLocalAuth) != true), pack('Finding', 'Key-based (local) authentication enabled', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Turn off local authentication and use Entra ID'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.documentdb/databaseaccounts' and (tobool(properties.disableLocalAuth) != true), pack('Finding', 'Key-based (local) authentication enabled', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Turn off local authentication and use Entra ID'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts' and (tobool(properties.disableLocalAuth) != true), pack('Finding', 'Key-based (local) authentication enabled', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Turn off local authentication and use Entra ID'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.appconfiguration/configurationstores' and (tobool(properties.disableLocalAuth) != true), pack('Finding', 'Key-based (local) authentication enabled', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Turn off local authentication and use Entra ID'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.signalrservice/signalr' and (tobool(properties.disableLocalAuth) != true), pack('Finding', 'Key-based (local) authentication enabled', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', '', 'Fix', 'Turn off local authentication and use Entra ID'), dynamic(null)))
| mv-expand f = Findings
| where isnotempty(tostring(f.Finding))
| project Severity = tostring(f.Severity), Finding = tostring(f.Finding), id, Detail = tostring(f.Detail),
    Fix = tostring(f.Fix), Type = type, ResourceGroup = resourceGroup, subscriptionId

    | extend Pillar = case(Category =~ 'HighAvailability', 'Reliability', Category =~ 'Cost', 'Cost Optimization',

            Category),
        Impact = tostring(properties.impact),

        RecType = tostring(properties.recommendationTypeId),
        rid = tolower(tostring(properties.resourceMetadata.resourceId)),
        Savings = coalesce(todouble(properties.extendedProperties.annualSavingsAmount),

        Currency = tostring(properties.extendedProperties.savingsCurrency)
    | join kind=leftouter (
        resources
        | where not('*' in ({Workload}))
        | where tostring(tags['{WorkloadTag}']) in ({Workload})
        | project rid = tolower(id), inWorkload = true
      ) on rid
    | where '*' in ({Workload}) or inWorkload == true
    | where Pillar == 'Security'
    | summarize Advisor = count(), AdvisorHigh = countif(Impact =~ 'High')
    | extend k = 1
  ) on k
| extend Advisor = coalesce(Advisor, 0), AdvisorHigh = coalesce(AdvisorHigh, 0)
| project Signal = 'Security', Value = Findings + Advisor,
    Detail = strcat(High + AdvisorHigh, ' high · ', Advisor, ' from Advisor'),
    State = case(High + AdvisorHigh > 0, 'Unavailable', Findings + Advisor > 0, 'Degraded', 'Available')

resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.compute/disks', 'microsoft.compute/snapshots', 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers', 'microsoft.network/natgateways', 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses', 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces', 'microsoft.sqlvirtualmachine/sqlvirtualmachines', 'microsoft.web/serverfarms')
| where '*' in ({Workload}) or tostring(tags['{WorkloadTag}']) in ({Workload})
| extend Findings = pack_array(
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines' and (tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.osType) =~ 'Windows' and isempty(tostring(properties.licenseType))), pack('Finding', 'Windows VM with no licence type (Azure Hybrid Benefit not used)', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize), 'Fix', 'With Windows Server licences under Software Assurance, set the licence type to Windows_Server'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.sqlvirtualmachine/sqlvirtualmachines' and (tostring(properties.sqlServerLicenseType) =~ 'PAYG'), pack('Finding', 'SQL Server VM paying for its SQL licence', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', tostring(properties.sqlImageSku), 'Fix', 'With SQL Server licences under Software Assurance, set the licence type to AHUB'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines' and (tostring(properties.extended.instanceView.powerState.code) =~ 'PowerState/deallocated' and tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.managedDisk.storageAccountType) startswith 'Premium'), pack('Finding', 'Deallocated VM keeping Premium SSD disks', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize), 'Fix', 'Disks are billed while the VM is off: move long-stopped VMs to Standard SSD, or delete them'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces' and (toint(properties.retentionInDays) > 90), pack('Finding', 'Workspace keeps data searchable for more than 90 days', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(properties.retentionInDays), ' days'), 'Fix', 'Keep older data in long-term retention instead, unless it must stay searchable'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks' and (tostring(properties.diskState) =~ 'Unattached' and isempty(managedBy)), pack('Finding', 'Unattached disk', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(properties.diskSizeGB), ' GB ', tostring(sku.name)), 'Fix', 'Snapshot it if it may be needed again, then delete it'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses' and (isempty(tostring(properties.ipConfiguration.id)) and isempty(tostring(properties.natGateway.id))), pack('Finding', 'Unused public IP', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.name), ' ', tostring(properties.ipAddress)), 'Fix', 'Delete it, unless the address is reserved for a planned service'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines' and (tostring(properties.extended.instanceView.powerState.code) =~ 'PowerState/stopped'), pack('Finding', 'VM stopped but not deallocated', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize), 'Fix', 'Stop it from the portal or with deallocate: a VM shut down from inside is still billed for compute'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms' and (toint(properties.numberOfSites) == 0 and tolower(tostring(sku.tier)) !in ('free', 'shared', 'dynamic')), pack('Finding', 'App Service plan with no apps', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.name), ' x', tostring(sku.capacity)), 'Fix', 'Delete the plan: it is billed per instance whether or not it hosts apps'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers' and (tostring(sku.name) =~ 'Standard' and coalesce(array_length(properties.backendAddressPools), 0) == 0), pack('Finding', 'Load balancer with no backend pools', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Delete it: Standard load balancers are billed per rule'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/natgateways' and (coalesce(array_length(properties.subnets), 0) == 0), pack('Finding', 'NAT gateway on no subnet', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Delete it, or attach it to the subnets that need outbound access'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/snapshots' and (todatetime(properties.timeCreated) < ago(90d)), pack('Finding', 'Snapshot older than 90 days', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(properties.diskSizeGB), ' GB, taken ', format_datetime(todatetime(properties.timeCreated), 'yyyy-MM-dd')), 'Fix', 'Delete it if it is not part of a retention plan; use Azure Backup for long-term copies'), dynamic(null)))
| mv-expand f = Findings
| where isnotempty(tostring(f.Finding))
| project Severity = tostring(f.Severity), Finding = tostring(f.Finding), id, Detail = tostring(f.Detail),
    Fix = tostring(f.Fix), Type = type, ResourceGroup = resourceGroup, subscriptionId
| summarize Findings = count(), High = countif(Severity == 'High'), Resources = dcount(id)
| extend k = 1
| join kind=leftouter (
    advisorresources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.advisor/recommendations'
    | extend Category = tostring(properties.category)
    | extend Pillar = case(Category =~ 'HighAvailability', 'Reliability', Category =~ 'Cost', 'Cost Optimization',
            Category =~ 'OperationalExcellence', 'Operational Excellence', Category =~ 'Performance', 'Performance Efficiency',

        Problem = tostring(properties.shortDescription.problem),
        Solution = tostring(properties.shortDescription.solution),
        RecType = tostring(properties.recommendationTypeId),
        rid = tolower(tostring(properties.resourceMetadata.resourceId)),
        Savings = coalesce(todouble(properties.extendedProperties.annualSavingsAmount),
            12 * todouble(properties.extendedProperties.savingsAmount)),
        Currency = tostring(properties.extendedProperties.savingsCurrency)
    | join kind=leftouter (
        resources
        | where not('*' in ({Workload}))
        | where tostring(tags['{WorkloadTag}']) in ({Workload})
        | project rid = tolower(id), inWorkload = true
      ) on rid
    | where '*' in ({Workload}) or inWorkload == true
    | where Pillar == 'Cost Optimization'
    | summarize Advisor = count(), AdvisorHigh = countif(Impact =~ 'High')
    | extend k = 1
  ) on k
| extend Advisor = coalesce(Advisor, 0), AdvisorHigh = coalesce(AdvisorHigh, 0)
| project Signal = 'Cost Optimization', Value = Findings + Advisor,
    Detail = strcat(High + AdvisorHigh, ' high · ', Advisor, ' from Advisor'),
    State = case(High + AdvisorHigh > 0, 'Unavailable', Findings + Advisor > 0, 'Degraded', 'Available')

resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters', 'microsoft.insights/actiongroups', 'microsoft.insights/activitylogalerts', 'microsoft.insights/components', 'microsoft.insights/metricalerts', 'microsoft.insights/scheduledqueryrules')
| where '*' in ({Workload}) or tostring(tags['{WorkloadTag}']) in ({Workload})

content.json:
### Reliability
Can the workload survive the failure of a zone, an instance or a dependency, and recover its data? The checks look for single instances, resources not spread across availability zones, locally redundant data and SKUs Azure has retired. A resource in a region without availability zones is flagged too: record it as accepted if so.

### Cost Optimization
Is the workload paying for anything it does not use? The checks look for idle resources, licences paid in the VM price and data kept longer than needed. Advisor's right-sizing, reservation and savings plan recommendations carry its estimated savings a year. Resource Graph holds no spend: use Cost Management for what the workload costs.

content.query:
resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.compute/disks', 'microsoft.compute/snapshots', 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers', 'microsoft.network/natgateways', 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses', 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces', 'microsoft.sqlvirtualmachine/sqlvirtualmachines', 'microsoft.web/serverfarms')
| where '*' in ({Workload}) or tostring(tags['{WorkloadTag}']) in ({Workload})
| extend Findings = pack_array(
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines' and (tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.osType) =~ 'Windows' and isempty(tostring(properties.licenseType))), pack('Finding', 'Windows VM with no licence type (Azure Hybrid Benefit not used)', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize), 'Fix', 'With Windows Server licences under Software Assurance, set the licence type to Windows_Server'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.sqlvirtualmachine/sqlvirtualmachines' and (tostring(properties.sqlServerLicenseType) =~ 'PAYG'), pack('Finding', 'SQL Server VM paying for its SQL licence', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', tostring(properties.sqlImageSku), 'Fix', 'With SQL Server licences under Software Assurance, set the licence type to AHUB'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines' and (tostring(properties.extended.instanceView.powerState.code) =~ 'PowerState/deallocated' and tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.managedDisk.storageAccountType) startswith 'Premium'), pack('Finding', 'Deallocated VM keeping Premium SSD disks', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize), 'Fix', 'Disks are billed while the VM is off: move long-stopped VMs to Standard SSD, or delete them'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces' and (toint(properties.retentionInDays) > 90), pack('Finding', 'Workspace keeps data searchable for more than 90 days', 'Severity', 'Low', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(properties.retentionInDays), ' days'), 'Fix', 'Keep older data in long-term retention instead, unless it must stay searchable'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks' and (tostring(properties.diskState) =~ 'Unattached' and isempty(managedBy)), pack('Finding', 'Unattached disk', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(properties.diskSizeGB), ' GB ', tostring(sku.name)), 'Fix', 'Snapshot it if it may be needed again, then delete it'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses' and (isempty(tostring(properties.ipConfiguration.id)) and isempty(tostring(properties.natGateway.id))), pack('Finding', 'Unused public IP', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.name), ' ', tostring(properties.ipAddress)), 'Fix', 'Delete it, unless the address is reserved for a planned service'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines' and (tostring(properties.extended.instanceView.powerState.code) =~ 'PowerState/stopped'), pack('Finding', 'VM stopped but not deallocated', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize), 'Fix', 'Stop it from the portal or with deallocate: a VM shut down from inside is still billed for compute'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms' and (toint(properties.numberOfSites) == 0 and tolower(tostring(sku.tier)) !in ('free', 'shared', 'dynamic')), pack('Finding', 'App Service plan with no apps', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(sku.name), ' x', tostring(sku.capacity)), 'Fix', 'Delete the plan: it is billed per instance whether or not it hosts apps'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/loadbalancers' and (tostring(sku.name) =~ 'Standard' and coalesce(array_length(properties.backendAddressPools), 0) == 0), pack('Finding', 'Load balancer with no backend pools', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Delete it: Standard load balancers are billed per rule'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.network/natgateways' and (coalesce(array_length(properties.subnets), 0) == 0), pack('Finding', 'NAT gateway on no subnet', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', tostring(sku.name), 'Fix', 'Delete it, or attach it to the subnets that need outbound access'), dynamic(null)),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/snapshots' and (todatetime(properties.timeCreated) < ago(90d)), pack('Finding', 'Snapshot older than 90 days', 'Severity', 'Medium', 'Detail', strcat(tostring(properties.diskSizeGB), ' GB, taken ', format_datetime(todatetime(properties.timeCreated), 'yyyy-MM-dd')), 'Fix', 'Delete it if it is not part of a retention plan; use Azure Backup for long-term copies'), dynamic(null)))
| mv-expand f = Findings
| where isnotempty(tostring(f.Finding))
| project Severity = tostring(f.Severity), Finding = tostring(f.Finding), id, Detail = tostring(f.Detail),
    Fix = tostring(f.Fix), Type = type, ResourceGroup = resourceGroup, subscriptionId
| summarize High = countif(Severity == 'High'), Medium = countif(Severity == 'Medium'),
    Low = countif(Severity == 'Low'), Resources = dcount(id), Checks = dcount(Finding)
| extend rows = pack_array(
    pack('Signal', 'High severity', 'Value', High, 'Detail', 'findings', 'State', iff(High > 0, 'Unavailable', 'Available')),
    pack('Signal', 'Medium severity', 'Value', Medium, 'Detail', 'findings', 'State', iff(Medium > 0, 'Degraded', 'Available')),
    pack('Signal', 'Low severity', 'Value', Low, 'Detail', 'findings', 'State', iff(Low > 0, 'Degraded', 'Available')),
